intro: Pick the version that fits where you are sending it. The designed CV is made for people; the ATS-friendly versions are plain, single-column text built to be parsed reliably by applicant tracking systems.

items.title: Designed CV
items.description: The full visual version with photo, projects and skills. Best for recruiters and direct emails.

items.title: ATS-friendly CV
items.description: Plain text, standard headings, no photo or colors. Best for job portals and international applications.

items.title: ATS-friendly CV (Turkish)
items.description: The same plain layout in Turkish, suited to Turkish job portals.
